thread:
julie_support: FYI customer ACME reported a weird provisioning issue after their Okta connector rotation — new users are created but no roles are attached. Happening since ~09:04 UTC. Logs show 403 from group-mapper service. cc @michael_se @samir_iam

michael_se: ugh. any error snippets from the group-mapper logs?

julie_support: pasted below — trimmed: 
```
2026-03-09T09:04:12.342Z ERROR group-mapper request failed status=403 src=okta-sync service_account=svc-acme-scim msg="insufficient_scope: token missing group:write"
2026-03-09T09:04:12.343Z WARN mapper: skipped assigning role for user=jsnow@example.com group=eng-sre reason="permission_denied"
```

samir_iam: :eyes: that looks like the service account lost the group push scope during the connector rotation. Okta rotation job recently swapped client secret + reduced scopes if rotation failed half-way.

elaine_cs: Confirmed on the customer's audit: the connector rotation created a new service account but the admin had deselected "Group Push" during setup. So token has okta.groups.read only, no write. That would cause create-without-role: SCIM create user OK but group-to-role mapping fails because we don't see group membership.

julie_support: customer says they ran a manual "Sync now" from Okta and saw created users, but roles still missing. They need a quick workaround while we fix the connector.

michael_se: Quick repro steps I used locally — mimic their token scope and call group-mapper check endpoint: 
```
# simulate request with limited token
curl -s -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \
  https://internal-api.redwood/group-mapper/v1/validate?externalId=okta:acme | jq
{
  "status": "error",
  "code": 403,
  "error": "insufficient_scope",
  "details": "missing scope: group:write"
}
```

samir_iam: Temporary fix options: 1) re-run Okta connector rotation ensuring Group Push scope enabled (customer portal checkbox), 2) run a one-off migration using an admin token to re-evaluate all recent users and attach roles based on Okta groups, 3) add a fallback where group-mapper will query a cached Okta membership (not ideal). Recommend option 2 for fastest remediation.

elaine_cs: I can generate a safe admin re-sync job for ACME that only touches last 24h users. I need approval to use admin-priv token in the job.

julie_support: customer approved an admin one-off. Please outline commands & precautions.

samir_iam: Steps I ran and tested in staging: 
1) export ADMIN_TOKEN from vault (audit entry created)
2) run re-eval job:
```
POST /internal/batch-reconcile HTTP/1.1
Host: internal-api.redwood
Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN
Content-Type: application/json

{
  "customer_id": "acme",
  "lookback_hours": 24,
  "mode": "group_to_role"
}
```
3) job returns a report with rows: user, applied_roles, skipped_reasons. Verify that only users without roles are modified.

michael_se: After that job succeeded in staging, roles reappeared for the test users. We also should patch the connector onboarding flow to fail hard if group push scope not granted (do not create connector).

elaine_cs: I'll run the one-off now using a staffed maintenance window and capture logs. Will set last_message_ts to when finished.

deploy-bot: scheduled maintenance job 1719010200 started by elaine_cs for customer acme (one-off role reconcile). :white_check_mark:

julie_support: thanks. action items: 
- elaine to run the one-off job and paste success report (ETA 15–30m)
- samir to add an onboarding check (prevent connector creation without group:write) PR
- michael to add an alert when group-mapper returns >5% permission_denied in 5m window
- support to notify ACME about temporary fix & advise to re-run rotation with Group Push enabled

elaine_cs: job completed. report excerpt: 
```
2026-03-09T09:30:18.112Z INFO batch-reconcile acme report_rows=42 applied=38 skipped=4
skips:
 - user=svc-ci-bot@example.com reason=service_account_exempt
 - user=test.user@example.com reason=externalid_missing
```
All 38 expected users had roles attached. No failures.

julie_support: :tada: Passing along to customer. Please follow up on the onboarding check & alerting.

samir_iam: I'll open PR for the onboarding validation and link this thread. Draft summary: "fail connector create if token scope does not include group:write; add explicit UI warning about role assignment loss."

michael_se: I'll add an SLO alert and a short runbook entry: if group-mapper 403 errors spike, check connector rotations and service-account scopes first.

julie_support: closing loop with ACME next. Thanks team.

okta-integration-bot: note: customer acme connector rotation event id 5b3f2ed logged at 2026-03-09T08:59:47Z (rotation incomplete, user unchecked group push).

julie_support: leaving thread open for PR links and runbook entries. last update at 1719010500
